facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports the 2Africa subsea cable was declared complete and activated in late 2025, with MTN GlobalConnect (Bayobab) leading the landing in Ghana.
TechAfrica News states 2Africa is built on an open-access principle, with landing station operators providing equitable wholesale access to its capacity (cable-wide, including the Ghana landing).

systems.owner: Meta-led consortium (China Mobile International, Orange, Telecom Egypt, center3, WIOCC, MTN, Vodacom)
